Feeling hot and unmeasured temperature are supported by hpi-003; intermittent chills are additional detail not in gold.
Generated states weight is stable; gold only provides an absolute weight and later absence of weight loss but not explicit 'stable weight now'. This is consistent but not directly stated.
Lisinopril use is supported by med-001, but the statement that dose is listed as '200' and unclear is an added detail not present in gold.
Use of Lemsip 2–3 times per day is supported by med-003 and hpi-006, but specifying paracetamol/phenylephrine sachets and PRN is additional detail.
No allergy information appears in gold facts; NKDA is new information.
Seasonal hay-fever is not mentioned in gold; purely additional.

Hypertension on lisinopril is supported (pmh-001, med-001), but 'BP control status unknown' is added interpretation.

Gold only says to check fever with a thermometer in follow-up advice (fu-001); obtaining a thermometer and checking temperature regularly as a discrete plan item is additional structure, though not contradictory.

Gold does not mention sore throat or ear pain; denial of these symptoms is new information.
Gold does not mention chest pain as a symptom (only inspiratory pain); explicit denial of chest pain is additional.
